title: The invoiced work order card shows the representatives as plain text
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; Labor reads {Sales-rep-A} and Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}; it has been invoiced.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 1, board 1.17.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover over the representative rows and compare with board 1.17.
  2. Measure the gaps between the fields.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both labels with their names as plain text, with no box, arrow, + or remove x, as in the picture.
  • Step 2: every gap is 16 px.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S2-R17, S1-R6, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 1, board 1.17, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R17: “Once the work order is invoiced or paid, or when it is opened from its history, each field is plain text with the same label and wording, with no + or remove x. A work order with both fields shows both labels with their names.”
  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
